prompt:
You improve the first-run onboarding of a desktop pet app.

Funnel (conversion from the previous step, and time taken):
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 80.4%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.7%

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>
- [sign_in, account] Pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails)
- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Changes already shipped, in order (the current onboarding includes all of them): ['Move sign-in after pet adoption', 'Move sign-in after adoption certificate completion']
Changes already tested and stopped: ['Quick controls intro step', 'Centered sign-in layout with account recovery callout', 'Waiting screen stage redesign with desktop preview', 'Move sign-in after desktop waiting generation', 'Interactive waiting tips during pet generation']
Ideas the safeguards blocked (they cannot be tested, do not propose them again): ['Add dedicated desktop controls tutorial screen', 'Preset selection preview flow for custom pet photo upload', 'Account sign-in warning copy for pet sync', 'Split layout for choose path screen', 'Adoption certificate starter accessory badge', 'Pet name input and sound effect', 'Shift certificate flow after waiting step', 'Account sync clarity copy on sign-in', 'Starter bonus reward announcement on certificate', 'Carousel interactive path selection', 'Starter pet reward highlight badge', 'Move sign-in step after home intro', 'Stage layout redesign for adoption certificate', 'Account restoration hint on sign-in screen', 'Adoption completion treat bundle highlight']

Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
Reordering sign-in steps has been helpful overall (+4.5% average after noise correction), winning 2 out of 3 tests though one test showed no clear effect.
Home redesign changes have shown no clear effect across 2 tests (-3.0% average after noise correction).
Evidence is still thin for finish and new_screen changes, as only one test has been completed so far.
Evidence is still thin for sign_in redesign changes, as only one test has been completed so far.
Predictions have generally been too high, though round 7 was underestimated.

Propose 10 NEW changes, different from everything above. Each must be testable as a 50/50 test.
Return JSON {"candidates": [{
  "title": short name,
  "target_step": one of ['choose_path', 'sign_in', 'adoption', 'home', 'finish'],
  "type": one of ['copy', 'hint', 'wait_info', 'notification', 'layout', 'incentive', 'reorder', 'new_screen', 'new_flow', 'redesign'],
  "change": what the user sees differently, one or two sentences,
  "why": the evidence from the funnel or the support mail,
  "config": the exact switch for the app, as {screen: {field: value}}.
            Existing screens, in their current order: ['story', 'choose_path', 'sign_in', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos', 'adoption_certificate', 'waiting', 'home_intro'].
            Fields on any screen: {'headline': 'str max 80', 'body': 'str max 240', 'hint': 'str max 160', 'button_label': 'str max 30', 'layout': 'str', 'show_progress': 'bool', 'show_time_estimate': 'bool', 'notify_when_ready': 'bool', 'show_step_counter': 'bool', 'tip_delay_seconds': 'int max 60', 'components': 'list max 12', 'replace': 'dict'}. "layout" is one of ['card', 'carousel', 'centered', 'checklist', 'compact', 'default', 'full_bleed', 'grid', 'list', 'split', 'spotlight', 'stage', 'story_scroll', 'two_column'].
            "components" is a list of new elements added to the screen, each {"type": one of ['animation', 'badge', 'button', 'checklist', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'mascot', 'name_input', 'photo_picker', 'preview', 'progress', 'sound', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel', 'video'],
            "text", "label", "asset": "asset:<id>", "style": one of ['calm', 'emphasis', 'highlight', 'large', 'plain', 'playful', 'rounded', 'small', 'subtle'], "action": one of ['back', 'choose', 'next', 'open_tip', 'play', 'replay']}.
            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.
            Nothing on the sign_in screen may lead past it without signing in.
            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: Split view for story intro screen
candidates.change: Redesign the story introduction screen with a split layout to visually present the desktop pet concept alongside welcoming story copy.
candidates.why: The choose_path step has a large mean time (514s) and drops off users early. Clear visual story layout helps engage users quickly.

story.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Companion
story.body: Adopt or create a custom pet that lives right on your desktop while you work or play.

candidates.title: Desktop companion preview welcome screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated new preview screen right before home_intro showing interactive animation of the pet arriving on desktop.
candidates.why: Finish step conversion is 64.8% and support emails indicate users are confused about how pets appear and behave on the desktop.

new_pet_arrival.headline: Your Pet is Arriving!
new_pet_arrival.body: Watch your pet land safely onto your desktop toolbar.

candidates.title: Grid layout redesign for pick friend screen
candidates.change: Redesign pick_friend screen layout to a structured grid with choice card components showing pet previews.
candidates.why: Adoption step has the lowest conversion in the early flow (60.9%) and long median time (89s).

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your New Pet
pick_friend.body: Select a friendly companion to join you on your desktop.

candidates.title: Interactive pet traits quiz flow
candidates.change: Insert a new interactive personality quiz screen into the path selection flow to guide users to their ideal pet path.
candidates.why: Choosing a path takes a long average time (mean 514s), indicating hesitation or confusion on how to proceed.

new_personality_quiz.headline: What kind of pet companion fits your daily routine?

candidates.title: Time estimate and progress on generation screen
candidates.change: Show an explicit progress bar and estimated generation time counter on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: The waiting stage has median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing users to leave before setup completes.

waiting.headline: Generating Your Unique Companion...
waiting.body: This usually takes about 1-2 minutes. Please keep the app open.

candidates.title: Desktop placement helper hint on home intro
candidates.change: Add a persistent helper hint box on the home_intro screen explaining how pet controls and desktop visibility work.
candidates.why: Support mail highlights 3 bug reports about pets not appearing on desktop and 3 confusion reports about pet controls.

home_intro.hint: Tip: Look for your pet near your taskbar. Right-click the pet anytime to open quick controls or hide it.
home_intro.headline: Meet Your New Desktop Friend!

candidates.title: Simplified single sign-in callout copy
candidates.change: Update sign_in copy to clearly state that signing in saves your desktop pet to your cloud account.
candidates.why: 8 support emails mentioned pets missing or reset after signing in again, showing account sync confusion.

sign_in.headline: Save Your Pet to Account
sign_in.body: Sign in now so your desktop pet status and custom traits are permanently saved across sessions.

candidates.title: Background generation ready notification toggle
candidates.change: Add a system notification option on the waiting screen so users can minimize the app while pet generates.
candidates.why: Waiting times are long (mean 2336s), leading to app abandonment before setup finishes.

waiting.hint: We will notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet is ready!

candidates.title: Photo upload guidance and quality incentive hint
candidates.change: Add helpful photo quality tips and visual guidance on upload_photos screen to improve creation success.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or weird visual results.

upload_photos.hint: For best results, upload clear front-facing photos with good lighting!
upload_photos.headline: Upload Pet Photo

candidates.title: Compact step counter redesign for sign-in screen
candidates.change: Redesign sign_in layout to compact style with step counter display to reassure users sign-in is quick.
candidates.why: Sign-in conversion is 80.4% but mean time is 567s, suggesting hesitation at account creation.
